title: MiLo: Efficient Quantized MoE Inference with Mixture of Low-Rank Compensators
problem: MoE LLMs suffer large accuracy degradation at INT3 weight quantization; existing calibration-free methods yield poor accuracy and existing INT3 kernels lack measured throughput gains at batch size > 1.
motivation: MoE models like Mixtral-8x7B are memory-bandwidth-bound at inference; INT3 quantization can dramatically reduce memory footprint but previous approaches (GPTQ, RTN) require calibration data or fail to deliver real speedups at practical batch sizes.
method: The approach combines HQQ-based INT3 quantization (storing weights as 3-bit integers without calibration data) with adaptive low-rank compensators that use SVD (a matrix decomposition) to recover lost accuracy. For each layer, the compensator's complexity is chosen based on three factors: dense vs sparse layer type, weight distribution (kurtosis), and expert activation frequency. Both the quantized weights and compensators are jointly optimized and packed into INT3 format. The method includes a custom GPU kernel (W3A16 Tensor Core GeMM) that efficiently runs these 3-bit weights with multiple inputs at once through zero-bit-waste INT3 packing, fast binary-manipulation integer-to-float conversion, and asynchronous weight loading.
key_novelty: It provides the first GPU kernel proven to speed up mixture-of-experts models when processing multiple inputs at once using 3-bit weights, while recovering accuracy through calibration-free adaptive weight correction.
contributions: Calibration-free INT3 quantization + mixture of adaptive low-rank compensators (MiLo)
Adaptive rank assignment per layer using kurtosis and expert activation frequency
Zero-bit-waste INT3 packing with binary manipulation I2F dequantization for Tensor Core compatibility
Async global weight loading for prefetch/compute overlap in W3A16 GeMM kernel
Empirical speedup at batch size > 1 on Mixtral-8x7B (A100)

metrics.speedup: 1.2x over MARLIN backend for Mixtral-8x7B; 3x faster quantization vs GPTQ
metrics.accuracy: Recovers 87%+ accuracy at 22% compression ratio; MiLo-s2 surpasses GPTQ by 17% on Wikitext2 PPL

limitations: Low-rank compensators add inference memory overhead (though also quantized)
Kernel optimized for NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core ISA; portability not demonstrated
Expert activation frequency requires profiling runs
